title: CEW Training with Security Forces (BROLL)
credit_line_in_description: (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Gary Hilton)
description: Airmen assigned to the 18th Security Forces Squadron receive conducted energy weapons qualification training on Kadena Air Base, May 17, 2022. The training included knowledge-based training, hand-on exercises and exposure to CEW discharge. (U.S. Air Force video by Senior Airman Gary Hilton)
